title: Local cohomological dimension of an ideal
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $I$ an ideal of $R$. Let $\Gamma_I$ be the ideal-power torsion endofunctor [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor] and put $H_I^j(M)=R^j\Gamma_I(M)$. Define $\operatorname{cd}(R,I)$ as the supremum of the nonnegative degrees $j$ such that $H_I^j(M)\ne0$ for some $R$-module $M$, with empty supremum $-1$ and unbounded supremum $+\infty$. Equivalently, for a Noetherian ring it is the least integer $q\geq-1$ such that $H_I^j(M)=0$ for every $R$-module $M$ and every $j>q$.
